Title: REST Set/Reset assetPublicUrl Round-Trips Through GraphQL store Query

CAVEAT flagged for reviewer: the re-posted body includes only the core fields captured below (id/name/url/catalog/languages/currencies/defaultLanguage/defaultCurrency) — verify against the live Store PUT/POST OpenAPI contract that no OTHER required field is nulled by a partial body before promoting this case out of Draft.

[REST-OP fetch_store]
GET {{BACK_URL}}api/stores/@td(STORE_PRIMARY.id)
[REST-EXEC fetch_store]
[REST-CAPTURE fetch_store.body.id → S_ID]
[REST-CAPTURE fetch_store.body.name → S_NAME]
[REST-CAPTURE fetch_store.body.url → S_URL]
[REST-CAPTURE fetch_store.body.catalog → S_CATALOG]

Failure_Signals: REST POST returns non-2xx; GraphQL store.assetPublicUrl does not reflect the just-set value (stale read / cache not invalidated); reset POST fails leaving the shared B2B-store misconfigured for other parallel suites; any other store field (catalog/languages/currencies) changes value after this round-trip (full-body overwrite side effect)
